items.label: Suitable for Dogs
items.value: Interior size 24.6"L x 16.9"W x 21.3"H, this dog crate is fit for small dogs like Poodle, Pug, and Chihuahua. Choose as your needs

items.label: Save Space Barn Door
items.value: Our dog furniture crate uses a unique sliding barn door that not only saves space but also adds charm and beauty. The side door is 2 locks, providing easy access for your dog while ensuring excellent firmusesness and stability

items.label: Anti-Chew & Anti-Escape
items.value: Our dog kennel is designed to be anti-chew and anti-escape for your furry friend security. The edges of the boards are not exposed to the dog to avoid chewing on the boards, 0.4" tubes make this small dog crate escape-proof!

items.label: Wide Application
items.value: Our wood dog crate furniture is not just a comfortable resting place for your dog. Its modern country-style furniture design also can be used as a side table, a TV stand in your living room, a bedside table in your bedroom

items.label: Superior Material
items.value: Our wooden dog crate furniture is built to last. The boards are made of engineered wood with wear-resistant and easy-to-clean surface.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 x Accessory Bag, 1 x Dog Crate Furniture, 1 x Instructions
